from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLiabilityReport(BaseModel):
    """A record of total liabilities for a single company from one filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the filing")
    total_liabilities_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of total liabilities as reported")
    liabilities_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period covered by the filing")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[FinancialLiabilityReport]
